notes: 1.9.4.1 - Hotfix. Updates JEI to 19.44.0.401, which ldlib2 requires. If you are stuck on the 'Mod ldlib2 only supports jei 19.39.0.368 or above' screen, grab the JEI jar from the release page and drop it in your mods folder manually - the updater cannot run from that screen. Otherwise just relaunch.
